SELECT surplus_fund_calculation_id AS surplusFundCalculationId, user_id AS userId, connection_id AS connectionId,
total_current_balance AS totalCurrentBalance, selected_account_balance AS selectedAccountBalance, selected_account_ids AS selectedAccountIds,
estimated_next_income_date AS estimatedNextIncomeDate, adjusted_next_income_date AS adjustedNextIncomeDate,
estimated_living_expense AS estimatedLivingExpense, adjusted_living_expense AS adjustedLivingExpense,
estimated_scheduled_expense AS estimatedScheduledExpense, adjusted_scheduled_expense AS adjustedScheduledExpense,
recommended_emergency_fund AS recommendedEmergencyFund, adjusted_emergency_fund AS adjustedEmergencyFund,
calculated_surplus_amount AS calculatedSurplusAmount, final_surplus_amount AS finalSurplusAmount
FROM surplus_fund_calculation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY surplus_fund_calculation_id DESC LIMIT 1
